constituent_event.event: the one sampled [512,256] generator has full row rank and A_w <= (13/2) E[A_w] for every 1<=w<=512

probability_space.outer_selection: try at most 28 independent uniform binary 256-by-512 generators, retain the first satisfying the constituent event, and repeat only that one code
probability_space.routing: independent uniform row-coordinate permutations and independent uniform region permutations
probability_space.inner: independent uniform binary (M+1)-by-(M+1) linear maps at all N steps, sampled once and shared by all messages
probability_space.conditioning: the distance probability is conditional on any fixed outer constituent satisfying the constituent event

proof_accounting.all_zero_reference_tuple: retained in the positive upper bound
proof_accounting.arithmetic: Arb transcendental endpoints and exact setup rationals; positive binary64 recurrences advanced one ULP after every addition, multiplication, division, and power-of-two scaling

limitations: The exact constituent-event test may enumerate all 2^256 row messages; no efficient test or deterministic construction is supplied.
The claim concerns the RandomStepConv proof model, not RM2Sub.
No implementation or running-time claim is made for RandomStepConv.
